package http

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type onboardingGetterHTTPStub struct{}

func (onboardingGetterHTTPStub) Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

type onboardingPutterHTTPStub struct {
	input studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput
}

func (stub *onboardingPutterHTTPStub) Handle(_ context.Context, input studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	stub.input = input
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	return domain.NormalizeStudentOnboarding(domain.StudentOnboarding{
		StudentID: input.StudentID, DirectionCode: input.DirectionCode,
		SelfAssessedExperience: input.SelfAssessedExperience,
		KnownStacks:            input.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: input.DesiredStacks,
		GoalCode: input.GoalCode, GoalText: input.GoalText,
		PreferredLanguage: input.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: input.WeeklyMinutes,
		PreferredPace: input.PreferredPace, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
}

func TestStudentOnboardingRouteUsesTrustedStudentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	putter := &onboardingPutterHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler: &handlers.AnswerHandler{},
		StudentOnboardingHandler: &handlers.StudentOnboardingHandler{
			Get: onboardingGetterHTTPStub{}, Put: putter,
		},
	})
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, "/api/v1/student/onboarding", strings.NewReader(`{
		"expected_version":0,"direction_code":"backend","self_assessed_experience":"basic",
		"known_stacks":[],"desired_stacks":["go"],"goal_code":"first-job",
		"preferred_language":"ru","weekly_minutes":300,"preferred_pace":"balanced"
	}`))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if putter.input.StudentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" || putter.input.ExpectedVersion != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected put input: %+v", putter.input)
	}
}
